counter.line: And then the girl behind the counter
stanza: And then the girl behind the counter
She asks me how I feel today
I feel like Lovecraft in Brooklyn

counter.line: And take orders from the counter
stanza: I just wanna be my Dad
With a slight sprinkling of my mother
And work at the family store
And take orders from the counter

counter.line: I am waiting at the counter
stanza: I am sitting in the morning
At the diner on the corner
I am waiting at the counter
For the man to pour the coffee
And he fills it only halfway
He is looking out the window

encounter.line: Don't be my, don't be my, don't be my last strange encounter
stanza: Don't be my, don't be my, don't be my last strange encounter
The moment you came to, I swore I would change
Though neither one of us would leave unscathed
At least we'll both go on living
